**Finding: RENEWAL — compliant (no redline proposed).**

- **No auto-renewal exists.** Section 13.1 (p0627) sets a self-executing term running Product-by-Product and country-by-country until the Secondary Royalty Term (p0121) expires. There is no evergreen term, no "automatically renew," no successive renewal periods, and no non-renewal notice window anywhere in the document (searches for renew/extension/successive-term/price-uplift returned nothing responsive).
- **Section 14.4 (p0672)** reinforces this: post-expiry dealings "shall not be construed as a renewal or extension hereof."
- **Conditional elements are inapplicable.** Because renewal is not automatic, the 12-month term, 30-day opt-out, 60-day reminder and CPI/3% uplift cap conditions do not bite; any extension would require a mutually agreed written amendment, which is the preferred outcome.
- **Expiry outcome favours us:** Ono's Section 2.1 licences become non-exclusive, fully paid-up, irrevocable, perpetual and royalty-free with sublicensing rights — no lock-in to police.

No walk-away features (no multi-year auto-renewals, no >90-day notice window) are present, so we leave this term as drafted.
